info.name: Potions
info.description: Potions from the Crooked Moon Campaign

description.p: The potion is stored in jugs labeled “XxX,” with a skeletal smile drawn on it. The ghastly, blue-green liquor within has an overpowering smell and harsh taste.

When you drink from this glass jug, you become insubstantial for 1 minute. During this time, you can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force damage if you end your turn inside an object.
Heightened Potency. For the duration, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
The potion’s bottle is made from a hollowed-out gourd, and the thick, liquid inside is a deep orange that tastes of nutmeg and cardamom.

When you drink this potion, you are filled with good health and bounty, providing you with enough nourishment to sustain you for 1 day. For the next hour, when you regain Hit Points, you regain additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Heightened Potency. The additional Hit Points you regain are equal to half your level rather than your proficiency bonus (minimum +2).
You regain 3d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion. Whatever its potency, the potion’s red liquid glimmers when agitated.
